raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Follow-up to the review note on #1461.

The contributor guides said every public op function returns a `TupleDict`, including the `<op>_jax_<direction>` ones. `TupleDict` is an unregistered dict subclass, so `jax.jit` rejects it as a return value. This scopes `TupleDict` to PyTorch functions and tells JAX functions to return a plain tuple or dict, in `python/cudnn/AGENTS.md` and the cutedsl integration skill.

Check, with the `TupleDict` class from `python/cudnn/api_base.py` on JAX 0.11.2 (CPU):

- `jax.jit(lambda x: TupleDict(output=x + 1))(1)` raises `TypeError`.
- The same function returning a plain dict or a tuple works.

Docs only; no runtime change.

Add or update the operation package under the closest existing family, such as `python/cudnn/<operation>/`, `python/cudnn/gemm/cutedsl/dense/<operation>/`, `python/cudnn/gemm/cutedsl/grouped/<operation>/`, `python/cudnn/gemm/cutedsl/discrete_grouped/<operation>/`, or `python/cudnn/sdpa/<direction>/`.

 3. Export the public functions through the operation/family `__init__.py` files and `_LAZY_OPTIONAL_IMPORTS` in `python/cudnn/__init__.py`.
 4. Reuse the existing CuTeDSL dependencies in `[project] dependencies` unless the new kernel truly needs an additional package. The `cutedsl` extra now holds only `cuda-python`.
 5. Add FE OSS documentation and update the relevant overview or operation index links.

   - Accept preallocated runtime inputs/outputs and an explicit stream.
   - Allocate output tensors for common use.
